input: Join /data/employees.csv and /data/departments.csv on the department_id field. Produce /data/report.csv with columns: name, department_name, salary. Include a header row. Print the result.

transcript.final_response:
Created `/data/report.csv`:

```csv
name,department_name,salary
Alice,Engineering,120000
Bob,Marketing,95000
Carol,Engineering,115000
Dave,Sales,88000
Eve,Marketing,92000
```
tool_calls:
ls -l /data && printf '
--- employees ---
' && cat /data/employees.csv && printf '
--- departments ---
' && cat /data/departments.csv

awk -F, 'BEGIN { OFS=","; print "name,department_name,salary" } FNR==NR { if (FNR>1) dept[$1]=$2; next } FNR>1 { print $1,dept[$2],$3 }' /data/departments.csv /data/employees.csv > /data/report.csv && cat /data/report.csv

tool_outputs.commands:
ls -l /data && printf '
--- employees ---
' && cat /data/employees.csv && printf '
--- departments ---
' && cat /data/departments.csv
